_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Muntu akulwana Snake pa {width}×{height} gridi.
Ukongola nyoka {player_id}. Mipango ilowele: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (kapena w/s/a/d).
Lengo: kukula muda mrefu zaidi au uwe mrefu zaidi na kupata alama ya juu (kikomo cha zamu {max_turns} zamu).

game_action.invalid_death: Nyoka {player_id} afa kwa sababu ya mpango usio halali.

outcome.outlived: Wuye mupira wa nderi ye dǝ gǝna.
outcome.turn_limit: Kikomo cha zamu kimefikia - alama bora hushinda kipindi cha usawa.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Vikundi vya mwisho vya uwekaji wa nafasi (mbaya→bora): {groups}
